name: Replication Data for: Pathways to Bubble and Skyrmion Lattice Formation in Fe/Gd Multilayers
description: Raw + processed data and images for: Pathways to Bubble and Skyrmion Lattice Formation in Fe/Gd Multilayers by Tim Titze, Sabri Koraltan, Mailin Matthies, Timo Schmidt, Dieter Suess, Manfred Albrecht, Stefan Mathias, Daniel Steil. To navigate we strongly recommand to use the tree view to see the folder structure. Please confer to README files where necessary. Files may sometimes have their own internal Readme (e.g. Origin Files). Some data is only here in zipped form, due to large number of files and these zips have to be downloaded completely.
